name: Projected Strongly Shattered Dimension
definition: The **Projected Strongly Shattered Dimension** is the maximum largest-strongly-shattered-set size among all coordinate projections of $\mathcal{H}$. Equivalently, it is the VC dimension of $\mathcal{H}$.
graph_summary: Largest strongly-shattered-set size among coordinate projections; equal to VC dimension.
origin_references: The shattering/strong-shattering sandwich framework underlying this equality is due to \cite{bollobas1995defect}.

monotonic.proof: Projected strongly shattered dimension equals VC dimension. Every set shattered by a subfamily is also shattered by its containing class.

p_monotonic.proof: Projected strongly shattered dimension equals VC dimension. Every set shattered by a projection is shattered by the original class on the same coordinates.

doubly_monotonic.proof: By definition, being monotonic under both subfamilies and projections is doubly monotonic.

c_monotonic.proof: A conditioning is restriction to a subfamily followed by a projection; hence doubly monotonicity implies c-monotonicity.

strictly_monotonic.proof: Projected strongly shattered dimension equals VC dimension. For $\mathcal H=\{000,001,011,100\}$, conditioning the third coordinate gives two fibres of value 1, while the full class also has value 1.
